snippet.title: Smash Ultimate Stage Mod - Waterfall Basin (Madagascar Videogame)
snippet.description:
Download: https://gamebanana.com/mods/481435
Stage mod for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.
Waterfall Basin from the Madagascar Videogame,
that game was my childhood, it's still one of my favorite games off all-time,
so i had to make a Smash stage based on it.

This is Waterfall Basin from the 5th level,
Mysterious Jungle, nothing too groundbreaking,
just a simple stage over the normal Temple, no omega/battlefield versions.

"Ripped" using Ninjaripper,
so there's some missing stuff on the top part of the stage,
unfortunately there isn't a proper way of ripping this game.

This was just a WIP i had on my folder for some time,
and i wanted to finish those WIPS to clean the folder up,
honestly i love this game so much, i plan on doing every level as a stage mod XD.

Mod includes:
- Normal stage (NOT Wi-fi safe)
- UI

Hope you guys like it.
